2000. She divorces Bruce Willis after 13 years. They have 3 daughters.

2003. She meets Ashton Kutcher at a dinner. 2005, they marry.

2011. He replaces Charlie Sheen on Two and a Half Men. Forbes names him the highest-paid actor on TV: $24 million in a year.

That fall, reports say he cheated. November 2011, Demi announces she's ending the marriage.

December 2012. Ashton files for divorce. Demi asks for spousal support and for him to pay her legal bills.

November 2013. It's final. Neither gets spousal support.

Ashton goes on to invest early in Uber and Airbnb.

2019. In her memoir, Demi writes about his cheating.

2025. Her movie The Substance gets her the first Golden Globe of her career and an Oscar nomination.

$12.5 million for one movie. $24 million a year for him. $0 for her.

Should Demi Moore have walked away with half, or was walking away with nothing the right call?
